intro.title: MOG LIFE Coaching
paragraphs: Personalized bodybuilding coaching built around your goals, experience, and lifestyle.
Whether you’re looking to build muscle, lose body fat, improve your physique, or take your bodybuilding to the next level, MOG LIFE offers individualized coaching to help you get there.
No cookie-cutter programs. No unnecessary complexity. Just a structured plan, ongoing adjustments, and the guidance to make consistent progress.
We offer four levels of coaching depending on how much support you’re looking for.

packages.name: MOG LIFE Complete
lead: The full MOG LIFE experience. Our flagship coaching package and best overall value.

Complete is designed for clients who want comprehensive coaching that goes beyond training and nutrition. We take a detailed look at your physique, performance, health markers, recovery, and lifestyle to build a plan tailored to your goals.
included: Personalized training: A customized workout program built around your physique, experience, goals, equipment, and recovery capacity. Ongoing adjustments as you progress.
Nutrition coaching: Individualized calories, macros, cardio recommendations, and dietary adjustments for fat loss, muscle growth, or body recomposition.
Weekly check-ins: Detailed progress reviews using weight trends, photos, training performance, and other relevant data.
Ongoing communication: Direct messaging for questions, feedback, and guidance throughout your coaching.
Comprehensive onboarding: A detailed assessment and individualized kickoff plan outlining your training, nutrition, supplementation, and other relevant strategies.
Enhanced bodybuilding guidance: Education and individualized strategy discussions involving performance-enhancing compounds, peptides, and advanced supplementation when applicable.
Bloodwork review: Analysis of relevant lab markers in the context of your training, goals, and overall health.
Lifestyle and appearance optimization: Guidance on topics such as hair restoration, skincare, sleep, recovery, cognitive performance, nootropics, and other areas of personal optimization.
Additional support: Phone calls when appropriate for more involved discussions.
MOG LIFE merchandise: A complimentary MOG LIFE hat.
packages.investment: Investment: $2,200 paid upfront for six months of coaching.
investmentNotes: Equivalent to approximately $367/month, with onboarding and all included services covered by the package price.
packages.bestFor: Best for: Clients who want a comprehensive approach to physique development, performance, and personal optimization—and are ready to commit to six months of progress.

packages.name: MOG LIFE Monthly
lead: Comprehensive bodybuilding coaching with a lower upfront commitment.
Monthly is designed for clients who want individualized bodybuilding coaching and access to advanced guidance without paying for six months upfront.
You’ll receive the same core training, nutrition, and bodybuilding expertise as our flagship package, with a more focused scope and flexible ongoing billing.
included: Personalized training: A customized workout program with ongoing adjustments based on progress, performance, and recovery.
Nutrition coaching: Individualized calories, macros, dietary recommendations, and ongoing adjustments.
Weekly check-ins: Regular progress reviews and updates to your plan.
Ongoing communication: Direct messaging for coaching questions and guidance.
Comprehensive onboarding: A detailed assessment and personalized kickoff plan.
Enhanced bodybuilding guidance: Individualized discussions involving PEDs, peptides, and advanced supplementation when applicable.
Bloodwork review: Interpretation of relevant lab markers to inform your bodybuilding strategy.
details: Monthly focuses specifically on bodybuilding, training, nutrition, and performance. Broader lifestyle and appearance optimization—including dedicated hair restoration, skincare, and nootropic strategies—is reserved for Complete and VIP.
investmentNotes: The standard coaching rate is $400/month, with a one-time $400 onboarding fee split across your first two payments to make getting started easier.
The program is designed around an initial three-month coaching commitment. After that, coaching continues at $400/month.
packages.bestFor: Best for: Clients who want serious, comprehensive bodybuilding coaching with a lower initial payment and the flexibility of ongoing monthly billing.

packages.name: MOG LIFE Natty
prices: Or $800 for Three Months Paid Upfront
lead: Straightforward training and nutrition coaching focused on building a better physique.
Not everyone needs advanced supplementation, bloodwork consulting, or an extensive optimization protocol.
Natty is designed for clients who want a knowledgeable coach handling the fundamentals: effective training, appropriate nutrition, consistent progress tracking, and adjustments when needed.
included: Personalized workout program: A training split built around your goals, experience, available equipment, and schedule.
Nutrition guidance: Individualized calorie and macro targets for building muscle, losing fat, or improving body composition.
Biweekly check-ins: Progress reviews every two weeks to evaluate results and make necessary adjustments.
Ongoing adjustments: Updates to calories, macros, training volume, and exercise selection based on your progress.
Training phase transitions: Updated programming when moving between major phases, such as a cut and a gaining phase.
Basic supplementation: Guidance on foundational supplements such as creatine, protein, and other essentials when appropriate.
Coaching communication: Direct messaging for questions and clarification related to your training and nutrition plan.
details: Natty uses a streamlined onboarding process and focuses on executing the fundamentals well.
It does not include PED or peptide protocol consulting, bloodwork interpretation, advanced supplementation strategies, hair restoration, skincare, nootropics, or broader lifestyle optimization.
Training programs are updated when there’s a reason to make a change—not simply for the sake of introducing new exercises.
investmentBullets: $275/month with a three-month commitment ($825 total), or
investmentNotes: Coaching can continue after the initial three-month period.
packages.bestFor: Best for: Natural lifters, beginners, and experienced trainees who want professional training and nutrition guidance without the additional services included in our comprehensive coaching packages.

packages.name: MOG LIFE VIP
lead: Our highest level of individualized coaching, access, and personal attention.
VIP is designed for clients who want the most comprehensive MOG LIFE experience, with a greater level of direct involvement, priority communication, and proactive oversight.
This is a premium coaching relationship for individuals who value having a knowledgeable coach closely involved in their physique development, performance, recovery, and broader optimization goals.
packages.includedHeading: Everything included in MOG LIFE Complete, plus:
included: Twice-weekly progress reviews: More frequent opportunities to evaluate progress, troubleshoot issues, and refine your strategy.
Priority communication: Higher-priority access for questions, feedback, and coaching support.
Monthly strategy calls: A dedicated one-on-one call each month to review progress, discuss priorities, and plan next steps.
Proactive coaching: More frequent review of training, nutrition, recovery, and other relevant variables rather than relying exclusively on scheduled check-ins.

Comprehensive optimization: A coordinated approach to physique development, enhanced bodybuilding, supplementation, bloodwork, sleep, recovery, hair, skincare, cognitive performance, and other relevant lifestyle goals.
Premium onboarding: An extensive initial assessment and individualized strategy.
MOG LIFE merchandise: Complimentary branded merchandise.
details: VIP availability is intentionally limited to ensure each client receives the level of attention the service is designed to provide.
packages.bestFor: Best for: Clients who want a highly involved coaching relationship, premium access, and comprehensive support across bodybuilding, performance, and lifestyle optimization.

guide.title: Which MOG LIFE Package Is Right for You?
choices: Choose Complete if you want the full range of coaching services, comprehensive optimization, and the best overall value over six months.
Choose Monthly if you want advanced bodybuilding coaching but prefer a lower initial payment rather than paying for six months upfront.
Choose Natty if your primary focus is training, nutrition, and accountability, without advanced protocols or additional optimization services.
Choose VIP if you want our highest level of personal attention, priority access, and proactive coaching.
guide.closing: Every package is built around the same philosophy: individualized plans, evidence-informed decision-making, and adjustments based on your actual progress.

start.title: Ready to get started?
start.body: Reach out to discuss your goals, experience, and which level of coaching makes the most sense for you.
